steps.summary: On ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd3-n2 RD Bench Ticket"), a part was added: "fwrd3-n2 RD Part A" with Cost $100.00, Markup 25%, and the app-computed Price of $125.00 (visible in the parts table row). The table also shows a total row of $125.00 (price × quantity = 1). The part appeared after the dialog closed and the list refreshed. Screenshot: part-added.png.

On ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd3-n2 RD Bench Ticket"), a second part "fwrd3-n2 RD Part B" was added with Cost $200.00 and Markup 25%, while existing part "fwrd3-n2 RD Part A" (Cost $100.00, Markup 25%) remained untouched. The app computes: Part A Price = $125.00, Part B Price = $250.00, and the ticket Total = $375.00 (price × quantity). Both parts confirmed in the parts table on the detail view. Screenshot: both-parts.png.

On ticket RD-1015 ("fwrd3-n2 RD Bench Ticket"), edited Part A's cost from $100.00 to $150.00 (markup unchanged at 25%). The app now computes: Part A Price = $187.50 (cost $150.00 × 1.25). Part B remains untouched: Cost $200.00, Price $250.00. The ticket's parts total updated to $437.50. Screenshot: part-a-edited.png.

(a) Initial error text — alert: 'Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd3-n2 RD Part B" has no supplier'. (b) To satisfy the preconditions: the stored procedure's loop had assigned supplier "Bench Supplier" to Part A repeatedly but Part B still had no supplier — I opened Part B's Edit dialog, filled the supplier field with "Bench Supplier", saved it, then clicked "Mark Ready" (no further errors). (c) Final status: Ready — confirmed as the status badge on the page (the Mark Ready button is now replaced by Mark Draft and Mark Closed buttons). Screenshot: ticket-ready.png.

steps.summary: Both parts deleted — the parts table now shows "No parts on this ticket yet." (0 parts). The ticket was archived via the archive action (the "Archive ticket" button click triggered it, no precondition error was encountered since the ticket was already "Ready"). The app confirms the archive with an "Archived" badge alongside the "Ready" status badge, and provides an "Unarchive ticket" button. On the active ticket list, RD-1015 is only visible when "Show archived" is enabled (shown with "Archived" flag); it no longer appears in the un-checked active-only list. Screenshots: ticket-archived-detail.png, archived-list-confirm.png.
